rules.title: Static by default, smallest client directive
rules.what: Keep pages static and hydrate only the islands that need interaction, with the smallest directive that meets it (client:visible, client:idle, client:media before client:load).
rules.why: client:load downloads, parses and boots the framework before the user does anything, even for a component below the fold.
rules.how: client:visible for below-the-fold widgets; client:idle for non-urgent ones; check hydrated JS per route in the build output.

patterns.note: Island hydrated on load; check it must be interactive immediately.

verify.how: Hydrated JS per route measured in the build report.

rules.title: Images through the build pipeline, accessible fallbacks
rules.what: Use the Image/Picture components (astro:assets) so formats, sizes and dimensions are produced at build time; keep alt text and content usable without client JavaScript.
rules.why: A raw img skips build-time optimisation: no modern format, no responsive sizes, no dimensions, paid by every visitor on every load.
rules.how: import { Image } from 'astro:assets'; <Image src={hero} alt="..." widths={[400, 800]} />.

patterns.note: Raw img tag; the Image component optimises at build.

verify.how: Content images go through astro:assets and carry alt text.
